description: Mistral SDK chat completion, one turn, traced by OpenInference through cetra's SDK.
notes: The Mistral client keeps its default base URL https://api.mistral.ai, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). The SDK is imported from mistralai.client, the module the instrumentor uses. The instrumentor writes llm.provider mistralai, which resolves to mistral_ai through the alias list (D-IN-2). Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.

message.text: The capital of France is Paris.
